label: sample facts (test fixture written from SPEC.md, not live lab memory)

facts.text: no-three-in-line-75: the leaderboard record is 148 points (Thomas-Prellberg); 149 points would be a new record and 150 would settle D(75)=150.
mirror-149 SAT class: after 300 rounds of lazy line constraints with cadical195, violated lines plateau at about 120.
rot180-150 class, glucose4, seed 2: round 41 reached with 212 violated lines at t=95s after adding 3184 lines.
diag-149 runs use the maplechrono solver; the --presolve-slopes flag cut violated lines from 260 to 180 in the first 20 rounds.
nothree_sat with glucose4 is about 1.8x slower per round than cadical195 on the mirror-149 class.
Cycle 12 decision: stop the none-150 SAT runs because their violated lines stayed above 400 for 6 consecutive cycles; the freed cores go to mirror-149.
Spencer discrepancy record is 7/sqrt(17) = 1.697749 (Youhua-Li), a 17x17 sign matrix with discrepancy 7.
spencer_gpu n=20 D=8 seed 0 on GPU 0: best_bad dropped to 3 bad vectors after 2.1M tabu steps, then stalled for 40 minutes.
spencer n=18 D=8: the paley init is stuck at best_bad=12 while the random init reached 6 bad vectors within an hour.
Prediction 'spencer n=20 D=8 reaches 0 bad vectors within 120 min' was refuted: 3 bad vectors were observed at the horizon.
The critic ran the official verifier on FOUND_spencer_n17.json: score 1.697749 ties the record, so it is not a new record (minImprovement is 1e-6).
Exa found the corrected Pesenti-Vladu arXiv 2211.05509: the asymptotic upper bound is 4.1 sqrt(n); the earlier 3.7 claim was wrong.
hadamard-det-51 record is log10|det| = 43.33745596194037 (kgrey); our GPU batched tabu from record matrices is at 43.3361, a gap of 0.0013.
hadamard_gpu seed 6 with perturb 4 and tenure 30 found best_log10 43.3361 at step 880k; seeds 1 to 5 are all below 43.30.
The sidon-45-set record is 4/7, from Ma-Tang's 14-point set (largest Sidon subset h=8).
sidon_extend proved there is no 1-point extension of the Ma-Tang set and no 2-point extension with new points in [-3000, 4000].
In a (4,5)-set no four distinct elements satisfy a+b=c+d, so Sidon failures come only from 3-term arithmetic progressions.
A Modal batch of 8 sandbox programs for sidon-45-set: all 8 valid, best score 4/7 (no improvement), median runtime 82 s.
Tinker RL on Qwen3-8B: the base model outputs squares or triangular numbers, which fail the (4,5) condition, so its valid rate is 0 at step 0.
two-deletion-code-16 record is 226 codewords (kgrey); the twodel_ils strategy is being built by the strategies builder.
ring-loading-15 record is 1.125 (JSAgent-Ring15) using dyadic pairs such as 7/16 and 9/16; float searches must be re-verified with exact rationals.
Daubel's 13/10 upper bound caps ring loading at 1.3; AlphaEvolve's published 15-pair construction scores about 1.1190476.
snake-in-the-box-13 record is 2950 (kgrey); it is not attacked because no cheap strategy is expected to beat it.
GPU box: 8x A100 40GB and 124 CPU cores; GPUs 0-3 run spencer_gpu, GPUs 4-7 run hadamard_gpu and about 110 cores run nothree SAT solvers.
Update: mirror-149 violated lines dropped from about 120 to 96 at round 340 after enabling --presolve-slopes on cadical195.
Update: spencer n=20 D=8 seed 0 restarted with tenure 24; best_bad is now 2 bad vectors after 3.4M steps.
